scientific_integrity: An unconditional exact divisibility proof is supplied; the finite verifier is corroborative, not an infinite proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statement treats only distinct-prime squares with exponents two and a power of two at least four, not all bi-unitary harmonic numbers. The low exponent-two neighbor is not asserted new; historical priority has residual risk.
title: Binary-exponent rigidity for bi-unitary harmonic two-prime squares
